title: fix: shutdown waits on optional worker reconciliation
body:
Related: #178538, #176777, #172971

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes shutdown waiting indefinitely for optional worker reconciliation when an allocation lookup never returns or reconciliation is queued behind an admitted provider mutation.

## User Impact

A stopped Gateway can leave optional reconciliation without discarding the durable allocation or cleanup intent. Existing explicit destroys and admitted provider mutations still settle before their owner closes. Pending shutdown diagnostics now identify the environment, provider, and operation.

## Why This Change Was Made

The affected Team deployment included #178538. That change bounded inspection, but the allocation lookup in `provider-owner-lifecycle.ts:313` still entered the provider queue without the reconciliation cancellation signal. The environment lock also admitted an uncancellable observer wait, and placement joined the whole shared sweep.

The environment owner now passes reconciliation cancellation into read-only allocation lookup and checks it before recording errors or publishing a late allocation identity. Queued reconciliation can stop waiting before it acquires the lock; its retained callback checks shutdown before doing work. The shared sweep exposes a shutdown-cancellable observation while retaining actual work in the existing owner joins. Provider queue ownership for mutations is unchanged. No schema or public provider contract changes.

The complete incident journal does **not** identify an environment, provider, or leaf call. This fixes reproducible remaining cancellation gaps and adds bounded diagnostics, without claiming to have identified the production leaf. Pending traces name lock/inventory, installation/credential, and provider-call stages (inspect, resolve-allocation, provision, destroy, SSH identity). Provider identity is captured at call admission, so formatting still identifies the call after inventory reads are closed. Direct reconciliation preserves inventory recovery by awaiting readiness before reading diagnostic provider identity.

Accepted limitation: a provider mutation or admitted durable effect still has to settle; shutdown cannot safely abandon it or fabricate its receipt. Providers without a cancellation API may finish a read-only request later; its result cannot resume the cancelled reconciliation or cause destruction.

## Evidence

Sanitized Team journal, `team-20261022-full-1638-1647.log.gz`, decompressed line 1435:

```text
2026-10-22 16:47:25.613 UTC shutdown deadline reached
worker-environments.reconcile.environment=268475ms
worker-placement.reconcile.environments=248785ms
shutdown.connection-dependent-sidecars=83170ms
shutdown.worker-placement.reconcile.active=83169ms
```

Those repeated counters put the two reconciles at approximately 16:42:57 and 16:43:16, before the 16:46 shutdown. The supplied journal records main-process `9/KILL` at 16:47:30; it does not identify the sender or attribute later SSH children to this reconcile.

The regression uses the real placement/environment owners with a provider allocation lookup that never returns. Close must finish within the test's 10-second limit before releasing that lookup, preserve the exact saved intent, avoid provision/bootstrap/destroy, and expose attributable diagnostics. A second owner regression releases queued reconciliation while retaining an admitted destroy until its actual completion.

Validation: 88 focused tests passed across the placement-startup cleanup, service inventory/lifetime, provider reconciliation, allocation cleanup, and destroy-timeout suites. The latest rerun passed both inventory tests in 1.5 seconds of test time (36.7 seconds including compilation) and all nine sidecar tests in 3.6 seconds (11.1 seconds total); the stalled-lookup regression completed in 232 ms. Core and affected test typechecks, targeted oxlint, formatting, and docs link audit passed. Both cancellation regressions fail on unchanged main. The diagnostic regression also fails when formatting tries to read an unavailable inventory, and passes with the captured call identity. GitHub review identified an eager diagnostic read that blocked direct inventory recovery; the extended seal/reopen test failed before that correction and now passes. Independent local and final committed-branch Codex reviews returned scoped-clean with no actionable P0–P2 findings. Exact-head CI run [39828882493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39828882493) completed with 57 successful jobs, 27 conditional skips, and zero failures on `ec774ce617dde37bca4cd267801d5c36a2ab1d31`, with no rerun or inherited-failure exception.

Production: +161/-70 (net +91). Tests: +68/-14 (net +54). Docs: +10/-0. The production growth is cancellation boundaries and bounded diagnostic context, with the existing provider queue moved intact into its owning helper; no new scheduler or state owner.

<details>
<summary>Focused proof commands</summary>

```sh
pnpm test src/gateway/worker-environments/service-inventory-recovery.test.ts src/gateway/worker-environments/service-lifetime.test.ts src/gateway/worker-environments/provider-allocation-cleanup.test.ts src/gateway/worker-environments/provider-reconciliation.test.ts src/gateway/worker-environments/provider-destroy-timeout.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
pnpm test src/gateway/server-worker-placement-startup-cleanup.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.gateway-other.json --incremental
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.gateway-root.json --incremental
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json <changed-ts-files>
node scripts/run-format.mts --write <changed-files>
pnpm docs:check-links
git diff --check
```

The final allocation-lookup regression times out at 10 seconds on unchanged main, and passes in 793 ms with the fix. The queued-reconcile regression also fails on unchanged main and passes with the fix. Tests use synthetic external I/O and real owners; no live Gateway was touched.
</details>

Initial CI on `a848219915e31f14ca334f423f625277caf07bc0` reported a skill-library worker E2E timing failure: the assertion received the legitimate `pending`/queue observation before provider start. The test and `agent.wait` owner are unchanged from main; the isolated test passed on both that PR head and the exact main base. A cancelled Security Review attempt was also reported by the rollup watcher; the independent security-sensitive status was successful. The final-head run passed, including the skill-library test; no rerun was required.
